title: 第7章 凯撒 尤利西斯第8章 入学资格
slug: 穿越成了游戏里的炮灰角色
content_zh:
阳光透过树叶洒下斑驳的光影，照在他们身上，仿佛给他们披上了一层金色的纱衣。
法伦和千代沐浴在这美丽的晨曦之中，运动完的心情格外舒畅。
他们一起漫步回到宿舍，享受着这清晨难得的时光。
到了三楼楼梯口，两人停住脚步，互相微笑着道别。
千代的房间就在三楼。
在与千代的聊天中，法伦了解到，住在宿舍二楼的基本上都是帝国贵族子弟，封魔将军的次子凯撒当然也是其中之一。
一楼和三楼则住着外乡贵族、骑士子弟和一些有名召唤师的学徒。
至于四楼，则是专门留给像法伦和妮可这样的平民。
法伦回到自己的房间之后，看了眼书桌上的时钟，发现已经过去了四十分钟，自己身体的孱弱程度真的超乎想象，麻溜地冲了个澡，换上干净的校服，换下来的运动服随手扔到了浴室门口的脏衣篓里，听千代说每天会有小精灵过来收衣服，第二天一早便会洗干净放回宿舍门口。
“明明其他事情都这么方便，怎么没有考虑到吹风筒呢？”
此时的法伦正坐在书桌前，用毛巾揉搓着湿漉漉的头发。
“对了，今天早上毅力、体魄和魅力的数值都涨了。
但是要查看的话得进系统空间，有点麻烦。
这玩意怎么一点都不人性化呢？”
这样想着，法伦任由毛巾搭在头上，随手从书架上摸了个笔记本。
打开新的一页，写上日期召唤历295年2月26日，似乎是想模仿一下系统得界面，法伦工工整整地写下：
【勇气：15100】
【魅力：27100】
【毅力：5100】
【体魄：2100】

【学力：0100】
“看着就像是游戏里的属性界面。”
法伦赞叹一句，随即又用笔在学力下面戳了戳，“学力对应的应该是知识吧。”
看着空空的书架，这怎么都不像是有知识的学生。
“得去图书馆借点书。”
法伦给自己的代办事项又加了一项，接着又写下了诸如，锻炼、下厨等等能增加五维数值的活动。
不知不觉时间已经七点过半了，法伦合上了笔记本，理了理校服，准备下楼早会。
刚出门便遇到了同样准备出门的妮可，这时法伦才发现校服似乎还有男女款式的不同，女生款校服的外套要短很多，并且下装是墨绿色的百褶裙，而不是裤子。
二月尾的气温依然很低，妮可穿了黑色的裤袜和一双擦得闪亮的小皮鞋，看得出来是专门为了上学准备的。
两人互道早安之后便一同结伴下楼。
两人来到一楼的休息室，法伦之前也只是远远地在门口外看了一下，没想到这个休息室比他想象的要大上不少，容纳个五六十人绰绰有余。
或许是时间尚早，现在休息室聚集的人并不多，三三两两地分开着坐，低声交谈着。
法伦和妮可找了个边角的位置坐下，刚一坐下，妮可便低声说：“如果待会有时间得话，可以带你去商店街看一下，买些日用品和食材什么的。”
法伦一眼便能知道妮可的重点在食材上，感觉到有些好笑，但是也不戳破。
“学校里面还有商店街啊？大陆的货币可以用吗？”
法伦想起游戏里都是用学分购买商品的。
content_en:
The sun casts mottled light and shadow through the leaves, shining on them, as if covering them with a layer of golden gauze.
Fallon and Chiyo were bathed in the beautiful morning light, feeling particularly comfortable after exercising.
They strolled back to the dormitory together, enjoying this rare morning time.
When they reached the stairs on the third floor, they stopped and said goodbye to each other with a smile.
Chiyo's room is on the third floor.
During the chat with Chiyo, Fallon learned that the people living on the second floor of the dormitory were basically the children of the imperial aristocracy, and Caesar, the second son of the demon-sealing general, was certainly one of them.
The first and third floors were occupied by foreign nobles, knights' children and some apprentices of famous summoners.
As for the fourth floor, it was reserved for civilians like Fallon and Nicole.
After Fallon returned to his room, he looked at the clock on the desk and realized that forty minutes had passed. His body was really weak beyond imagination. He took a quick shower and put on a clean school uniform. The sports clothes he changed into were thrown into the dirty clothes basket at the bathroom door. Chiyo said that an elf would come to collect the clothes every day, and they would be washed and put back at the door of the dormitory early the next morning.
"Obviously everything else is so convenient, why didn't you consider a hair dryer?"
At this time, Fallon was sitting at the desk, rubbing his wet hair with a towel.
"By the way, the values of perseverance, physique and charm have all gone up this morning.
But if you want to check it, you have to enter the system space, which is a bit troublesome.
Why is this thing not humane at all? "
With this thought in mind, Fallon let the towel rest on his head and casually grabbed a notebook from the bookshelf.
Open a new page and write the date February 26, 295 in the Summoning Calendar. As if to imitate the system's interface, Fallon neatly wrote:
【Courage: 15100】
【Charm: 27100】
【Perseverance: 5100】
[Physique: 2100]
[Academic ability: 0100]
"It looks like the property interface in a game."
Fallon admired, and then poked under academic ability with a pen, "Academic ability should correspond to knowledge."
Looking at the empty bookshelves, this does not look like a knowledgeable student.
"I have to go to the library to borrow some books."
Fallon added another item to his to-do list, and then wrote down activities such as exercising, cooking, etc. that can increase the value of the fifth dimension.
Unknowingly, it was past half past seven. Fallon closed his notebook, straightened his school uniform, and prepared to go downstairs for the morning meeting.
As soon as he went out, he met Nicole who was also preparing to go out. Only then did Fallon realize that the school uniforms seemed to have different styles for men and women. The jackets of the girls' school uniforms were much shorter, and the bottoms were dark green pleated skirts instead of trousers.
The temperature was still very low at the end of February. Nicole wore black pantyhose and a pair of shiny leather shoes. It was obvious that she was specially prepared for school.
The two said good morning to each other and went downstairs together.
The two came to the lounge on the first floor. Fallon had only looked outside the door from a distance before. Unexpectedly, the lounge was much larger than he imagined, and could accommodate fifty or sixty people.
Perhaps it was still early, but there were not many people gathered in the lounge now. They were sitting apart in twos and threes, chatting in low voices.
Fallon and Nicole found a corner seat and sat down. As soon as they sat down, Nicole whispered: "If you have time later, I can take you to the shopping street to buy some daily necessities and ingredients."
Fallon could tell at a glance that Nicole's focus was on the ingredients, and found it a bit funny, but not too revealing.
"Is there a shopping street in the school? Can mainland currency be used?"
Fallon remembered that in the game, you use credits to purchase goods.
